title: BruceMemoryExecutionState
description: Runtime execution state for in-progress or recently completed operations

current_extraction_job_id.description: ID of currently running extraction job, if any

learnings_processed_this_cycle.description: Number of learnings processed in current extraction cycle

patterns_added_this_cycle.description: Number of new patterns created in current extraction cycle

patterns_updated_this_cycle.description: Number of existing patterns updated in current extraction cycle

current_query_queue_length.description: Number of on-demand queries currently in queue

active_queries.description: List of active query IDs being processed
